desc: The Uttarakhand Avalanche 2025 was a deadly avalanche that struck a Border Roads Organisation camp on February 28, 2025, near Mana village in the Chamoli district of Uttarakhand, India. The avalanche buried 54 workers inside eight containers and a shed at an altitude of over 10,000 feet, close to the India-China border. The incident occurred between 5:30 AM and 6:00 AM IST, in an area prone to avalanches and extreme winter conditions.
